models.name: multi_user_todo_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts identified by device fingerprint for unauthenticated access.

This table stores guest user sessions that allow unauthenticated visitors to access the system without creating a full member account. Each guest is uniquely identified by a device fingerprint combination.

Guest accounts are temporary and may be cleaned up periodically. They enable basic functionality for users who have not yet registered or logged in.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the guest account.

plainFields.name: fingerprint_hash
plainFields.description:
Hashed device fingerprint used to uniquely identify guest sessions.

Combined from user agent, IP address, and browser characteristics to create a persistent identifier for unauthenticated users.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Browser user agent string captured at session creation.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: Client IP address captured at session creation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description:
Current status of the guest session.

Values: active, expired, deleted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this guest account.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft deleted.

models.name: multi_user_todo_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access without full authentication.

Maintains audit trail of guest device and access information with explicit expiration. Each session belongs to exactly one guest account and is managed through the guest's lifecycle.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_guest_id
foreignFields.description:
Reference to the guest account that owns this session.

Each session belongs to exactly one guest and is deleted when the guest account is deleted (cascade delete).

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the device that created this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where the guest session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from the guest's browser, indicating how they arrived at the site.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for this session. Sessions become invalid after this time.

models.name: multi_user_todo_members
models.description:
Registered member accounts with email and password authentication credentials for the multi-user todo application.

## Identity and Authentication

Stores user login credentials including unique email address and bcrypt-hashed password. Used exclusively for member actor authentication and authorization.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description:
Unique email address for user authentication and identification.

Must be lowercase, unique across all accounts, and used as the primary login identifier.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description:
Bcrypt-hashed password for secure authentication.

Never stored in plaintext. Updated when user changes password during account management flows.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null when account is active, set when account is deleted to mark for permanent removal.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh token support.

Stores active login sessions for authenticated members. Each session is associated with exactly one member account and includes client context (IP, referrer, last URL). Sessions expire automatically and are cascaded when the member account is deleted.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key reference to the member account that owns this session.

Establishes a 1:N relationship where each session belongs to exactly one member. When the member account is deleted, all associated sessions are automatically deleted (cascade). This ensures orphaned sessions are never created or left behind when accounts are removed.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description:
Client IP address when the session was created.

Used for security auditing and detecting suspicious login activity from different locations.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description:
Last visited URL path when the session was active.

Provides context about which page the member was viewing when the session token was generated or last used.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description:
HTTP Referrer header value when the session was created.

Indicates which page or external site the member came from when logging in or creating the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the session was first created.

Records the exact moment the member logged in and the session token was issued.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.

Used for automatic session cleanup and security. Sessions must be refreshed or re-authenticated before this time.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for member account recovery, providing secure temporary access to reset forgotten passwords.

This table stores one-time use tokens that members receive via email after requesting a password reset. Each token is tied to a specific member account and expires after a predetermined time period for security. Once a token is used to reset a password, it is immediately invalidated and marked for deletion.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description:
References the member account requesting the password reset.

This foreign key ensures each reset token is associated with exactly one member account. The relationship is 1:1 - a member can have at most one active password reset token at any time. When the member account is deleted, all associated reset tokens are cascaded and deleted.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description:
Unique secure token string for password reset.

A cryptographically random token (at least 32 characters, typically 64+ characters using random string generation) that is sent to the member's registered email address. The member includes this token in the password reset form submission. Tokens are single-use only - once a token is successfully used, it is immediately invalidated and cannot be reused.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this password reset token expires.

The token becomes invalid after this datetime passes. Tokens typically expire after 1-24 hours depending on security policy. The system must reject any token whose expired_at timestamp is in the past, even if the token has not been used yet. This prevents long-term security risks from compromised or leaked tokens.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this password reset token was created.

Used to track token age and enforce expiration policy. The difference between created_at and current time should not exceed the allowed token lifetime window.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this password reset token was last updated.

For token tables, this field is typically not updated after creation as tokens should be immutable until deletion. However, it is included here to maintain consistency with the temporal field pattern used across all business entity tables.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for registration confirmation and validation.

Each token is a one-time use code that expires after a short period to prevent unauthorized verification. Tokens are created during registration and must be validated before the user account becomes fully active.

Relationships:
- Belongs to exactly one {@link multi_user_todo_members} through member_id foreign key
- Tokens are invalidated after verification or expiration

Indexes optimize lookup by email, member, and expiration for security token cleanup.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description:
References the member account associated with this email verification token.

Each email verification is tied to exactly one member account. The token is used to verify ownership of the email address associated with that member.

Deleted at cascade: When a member account is deleted, all associated email verification tokens are permanently removed to maintain data integrity and prevent orphaned records.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description:
Unique verification token used to confirm email ownership during registration.

This is a secure, randomly generated string that must be submitted to verify the email address. Each token can only be used once for verification.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description:
Email address being verified during the registration process.

This matches the email address provided when creating the member account. Used as a reference to identify which email is being verified.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this verification token expires.

Tokens are short-lived for security purposes. Expired tokens cannot be used for verification and will be periodically cleaned up by the system to prevent accumulation of stale tokens.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this verification token was created.

Used to determine token age and for audit trail purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this verification token record was last updated.

Used to track when verification attempts or token refreshes occur.

models.name: multi_user_todo_todos
models.description:
Main todo entity with lifecycle tracking including completion status, soft delete, and date fields.

Business entities representing individual tasks or to-do items that users can create and manage. Each todo belongs to exactly one member user and can track its completion state, soft deletion status, and optional date fields for scheduling.

Lifecycle Management: Todos support a soft-delete pattern where deleted todos move to trash (is_deleted=true, deleted_at set). They can be restored from trash (is_deleted=false, deleted_at=null) or permanently deleted. Completion status is tracked with is_complete boolean flag that can be toggled.

Date Fields: Optional start_date and due_date fields enable basic scheduling and filtering. Todos without start_date appear at the end when sorted by start_date. Todos without due_date appear at the end when sorted by due_date.

Data Ownership: Each todo is owned by exactly one member user and is private - users can only access their own todos.

See {@link multi_user_todo_member_sessions} for session management, {@link multi_user_todo_todos_edits} for edit history audit trail.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key identifier for the todo.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description:
References the member user who owns this todo.

Cascade delete ensures all todos are removed when a member account is deleted. Users can only access their own todos through this foreign key relationship.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description:
Todo title or name.

Required field with a maximum length of 255 characters to ensure concise task identification. This is the primary identifier shown in todo lists.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description:
Optional todo description or additional details.

Can be empty or null if no additional context is provided. Supports flexible todo item definitions.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description:
Optional start date when the todo begins.

When sorting by start_date, todos without a start date appear at the end of the list. Enables basic task scheduling and chronological organization.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description:
Optional due date when the todo should be completed.

When sorting by due_date, todos without a due date appear at the end of the list. Enables deadline tracking and priority management.

plainFields.name: is_complete
plainFields.description:
Completion status flag for the todo.

Defaults to false when created. Can be toggled to true when the todo is finished. Users can mark todos as complete or return them to incomplete status.

plainFields.name: is_deleted
plainFields.description:
Soft delete flag indicating trash status.

Defaults to false. When true, the todo is in trash but not permanently deleted. Enables trash functionality for accidental deletion recovery.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the todo was soft deleted to trash.

Null when the todo is active. Set to current time when is_deleted becomes true. Can be cleared (set to null) when restoring from trash.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the todo was created.

Always set to the current time on create. Used for ordering and audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the todo was last updated.

Always set to the current time on create and each update. Enables tracking of most recently modified todos.

models.name: multi_user_todo_todos_edits
models.description:
Audit trail table recording all field changes to todos including old and new values for title, description, and date fields.

This table provides an immutable history of todo modifications, capturing what values existed before and after each edit. Each edit record is created only when at least one field actually changes during a todo update operation.

foreignFields.name: todo_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key reference to the todo that was edited.

When the referenced todo is permanently deleted, this edit record is cascade deleted to maintain referential integrity.

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last edited. Used for sorting edit history from most recent to oldest.

plainFields.name: old_title
plainFields.description: The todo title value before the edit. Null if title was not part of this edit.

plainFields.name: new_title
plainFields.description: The todo title value after the edit. Null if title was not part of this edit.

plainFields.name: old_description
plainFields.description: The todo description value before the edit. Null if description was not part of this edit.

plainFields.name: new_description
plainFields.description: The todo description value after the edit. Null if description was not part of this edit.

plainFields.name: old_start_date
plainFields.description: The todo start_date value before the edit. Null if start_date was not part of this edit.

plainFields.name: new_start_date
plainFields.description: The todo start_date value after the edit. Null if start_date was not part of this edit.

plainFields.name: old_due_date
plainFields.description: The todo due_date value before the edit. Null if due_date was not part of this edit.

plainFields.name: new_due_date
plainFields.description: The todo due_date value after the edit. Null if due_date was not part of this edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this edit record was created. Automatically set on insert.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this edit record was last updated. Always matches created_at for append-only edit records.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this edit record was soft deleted. Null if not deleted. Used for soft delete support.
